model_annotation: The figure shows a two-level donut (nested pie) chart that presents distributions for two related measures, with the outer ring labeled “Ambiguity Std (Outer)” and the inner ring labeled “Max Ambiguity (Inner).” The outer ring contains four slices, each in a distinct blue shade with percentage labels inside: “Std: 0.0” in a darker teal-blue at approximately 49.0%, “Std: 0.47” in a medium blue at about 39.0%, “Std: 0.82” in a lighter blue at about 5.0%, and “Std: 0.94” in the lightest cyan-blue at about 7.0%. The inner ring contains three slices in pale blue tones with percentage labels inside: “Max: 1” in a light blue at about 47.7%, “Max: 2” in a slightly different light blue at about 38.0%, and “Max: 3” in a very pale blue at about 14.2%. Two separate legends appear on the right, one for the outer-ring standard-deviation categories and one for the inner-ring max-ambiguity categories; no slices are exploded or otherwise emphasized, and the inner-ring segments appear arranged roughly from larger to smaller values, while the outer-ring percentages are not strictly ordered by size.
